channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Amnesty calls for US strike on Yemen to be investigated as war crime
item.description: The attack last year on a migrant detention facility killed at least 68 people.

item.title: How the US-Israeli war is collapsing the sanctions regime on Iran
item.description: Circumvention mechanisms already exist and the conflict is encouraging more entities to work with them.

item.title: When will Strait of Hormuz be ‘safe’ for commercial shipping again?
item.description: Even if the strait reopens, shipping insurance could cost 20 times more than before the war, analysts say.

item.title: How Iran has changed, and how it hasn’t, in two months of war
item.description: Common Iranians face job losses and shortages. But key institutions remain in place, with hardliners stronger now.

item.title: Down but not out: In war with Israel, Hezbollah shows it is still powerful
item.description: Despite setbacks, Hezbollah emerges as a key player, tied to Lebanon’s stability and US-Iran negotiations.

item.title: Trump reviews Iranian proposal aimed at reopening Strait of Hormuz
item.description: The White House confirms Trump met his national security advisers on Monday to discuss the plan.

item.title: Pakistan accused of attacking Afghan university
item.description: Air attacks on the province of Kunar have killed at least seven people and injured 75, sources tell the BBC.

item.title: Colombia offers record $1.4m-reward for rebel it blames for deadly bomb attack
item.description: Officials say a rebel leader known as "Marlon" ordered the attack in which 20 people were killed.

item.title: At least 42 killed in Chad after water well dispute escalates
item.description: The dispute was initially between two families before escalating into a cycle of reprisal attacks.

item.title: Kim Jong Un opens memorial for N Korean soldiers killed in Ukraine war
item.description: Kim Jong Un and Russian Defence Minister Andrey Belousov unveiled the memorial in Pyongyang.
